N2.text: Paste a link and choose languages. A Cloud Run job starts, and you watch the agent work. Chirp 3 timestamps every word and tells the speakers apart. Gemini listens to the audio, fixes the transcript, and translates each sentence to fit the time it was spoken.

N3.text: It handles conversations too. Here is Google DeepMind's podcast. Gemini listens to each speaker and casts a matching voice. Nobody's voice is cloned without consent.

N4.text: Then every line is checked by ear. Gemini listens to each clip: right language, every word, right length. Here it heard my company's name come out as "WhyBrick". The agent spoke the line again, listened again, and it passed. Whatever it can't fix, it flags for a human.

N5.text: And you stay in control. Here the agent dropped the show's name from a Korean line. I add it back, preview just that line in the same voice, Gemini checks it again, and I accept.

N6.text: It is all Google Cloud. Firebase hosts the studio. Cloud Run starts one job per dub, so it scales with creators and costs nothing when idle. Every agent decision streams through Firestore, and the media lands in Cloud Storage. On a full fifteen-minute video, three hundred sixty-six of three hundred sixty-nine lines passed the listening check, at about three cents per dubbed minute.
